cases.question: who is the conductor of the Linden Consort

cases.question: who is the president of the Ashtonleigh Gardening Club

cases.question: how many plays does the Wethercote Little Theatre put on each year

cases.question: how many members does the Sandling Choral Society have

cases.question: who founded Ashcroft Primary School

cases.question: who is the head of the Elmstead School for the Blind

cases.question: where does the Kingsway Jazz Orchestra rehearse

cases.question: what is the Wendham Lyceum

cases.question: when was the house at Ottersby Grange School built

cases.question: what is the name of the Brindle Players' theatre

cases.question: when did the Callen Academy of Music open

cases.question: what city is the Valder Opera based in

cases.question: how many choirs are in the Westerling Choral Federation

cases.question: how many pupils does Sorrelby Primary School have

cases.question: how often does the Blackmere Film Society meet

cases.question: when was the Gullhaven Sea Shanty Choir formed

cases.question: who founded the Rowley Institute

cases.question: is Hallowmere Collegiate School a boarding school

cases.question: what is the Briarwood Junior Conservatoire

cases.question: who leads the Felton Fiddlers

cases.question: who is the secretary of the Torley Rambling Club
